blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — About 350 families fled their homes following a firefight that erupted Thursday afternoon in Sitio Libal, Barangay Kulambog, Sultan sa Barongis in Maguindanao del Sur. Lt. Col. Ronald Suscano, spokesperson for the 6th Infantry Division, told the Inquirer that the clash involved the 105th Base Command of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front-Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces (MILF-BIAF) and an unidentified armed group. Initial reports indicated that residents of Sitios Libal, Silungan, Dundungen and Kimalong in Barangay Kulambog immediately evacuated for fear of being caught in the crossfire.
